text: On the pilot's questions about team-builder.txt (who the team-builder answers to; pilot entry point as the procedure paired with the roster; whether adversary is an axis or a seat; what Pilot leader means; whether team-builder comes before mini-spec): "- With agent teams I should be able to directly jump onto an agent session to answer questions. this could be a new type, \"direct interview\" or \"commander at the seat\" (what is the best naming here). - correct for pilot entry point. - adversarial is the axis name, how well does the team review itself. - yes forth, mentioned above, direct interaction. - this first, that is another session. lets do ITR shape as per T010. somebody also mines logs decisions for mistakes and takes etc. Output dossier first. then we you do a custom minispec team."
